# monotaur_notification_channel (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur notification channel by its ID. The channel's credential is write-only and not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_notification_channel" "oncall_slack" {
  id = "7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the notification channel to look up.

### Read-Only

- `auto_disabled_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when delivery disabled the channel after too many failures, or null.
- `body_template` (String) Scriban template of the message body, or null for the type's default.
- `consecutive_failure_count` (Number) Deliveries in a row that ended `Failed` (system-managed, read-only).
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the channel was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the channel sends notifications.
- `event_types` (Set of String) The CloudEvent types delivered to the channel.
- `name` (String) The display name of the channel.
- `recipients` (List of String) Email addresses an `Email` channel sends to; empty for other types.
- `subject_template` (String) Scriban template of the subject, or null for the type's default.
- `type` (String) What the channel delivers to: `Slack`, `Teams`, `Email`, `PagerDuty` or `Webhook`.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the channel was last updated.
